content_sections.heading: Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 54 vacancies are available - 30 for Unskilled Sanitation Workers, 4 for Electricians, and 20 for Heavy Vehicle Drivers.

content_sections.heading: Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Unskilled Sanitation Workers: Age 18 to 40 years, Physically Fit & deployed for Sweeping, Garbage Collection, Cleaning of Public Places, Drain Cleaning, Sanitation Drives. Minimum Qualification: 10th Pass. Electricians: Age 18 to 35 years, ITI Qualification (Electrician Trade) Capable of Maintain & Repair Street Lights, Central Lights, Electrical equipment. Minimum Qualification: ITI. Heavy Vehicle Drivers: Age 18 to 35 years, SSC/10th Class & Valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence. Minimum Qualification: 10th Pass.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Jangaon District Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 is 03-09-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Unskilled Sanitation Workers?
faq.answer: There are 30 vacancies available for the post of Unskilled Sanitation Workers in the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for Heavy Vehicle Drivers?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for Heavy Vehicle Drivers is 18 years. The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026. The application is free for all candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Electricians?
faq.answer: Electricians will receive a salary of Rs.550/- per day for their services in the Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for Electricians?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Electricians is an ITI qualification in the Electrician Trade. They should also be capable of maintaining and repairing electrical equipment.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it either in person or through registered post.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of SSC or Equivalent Examination, Intermediate or 10+2 Examination, Marks Memos, Study Certificate, Bonafide Certificates, and one photograph are required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: A total of 54 temporary posts are available across different categories in the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026.
